title: Relativity
coreMove: Change seats, inspect the frame, and widen the clock before trusting your first interpretation.
sourcePressure: Relativity is treated as a judgment model about vantage point, framing, incomplete information, and time horizon, not as technical physics.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: turning relativity into soft empathy or the claim that every viewpoint is equally true

counterintuition: turning relativity into soft empathy or the claim that every viewpoint is equally true

audit your life with no chapter-specific object
